lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Mathematical Habits and Place Value to One Million
lessonRef.title: Performance task: plan: the Ten Times Bigger explainer

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows how to plan before computing anything.

items.prompt: The digit 3 is in the thousands place in one number, and the digit 3 is in the hundreds place in another. How many times as great is the first?

steps: Thousands is one place left of hundreds.
Each place is 10 times the place to its right.
The first digit is 10 times as great.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Decide what the quantities are before you compute anything.

choices: Cannot be compared without more information

items.prompt: A digit 6 is in the hundreds place in one number, and the digit 6 is in the tens place in another number. How many times as great is the first digit's value compared to the second?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Plan in writing: what you will figure out, how, and how you will check it.

items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A digit 3 is in the ten thousands place in one number, and the digit 3 is in the thousands place in another number. How many times as great is the first digit's value compared to the second?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
